text:
Carmen L: quick sync — need a call on dedicated capacity contracting. two proposals on the table: a short 'commit window' model that gives flexible carryover vs a 'steady-slab' long-lived reservation. thoughts?
Eli V: +1, can we list tradeoffs? my gut: commit window easier for sales but harder for infra predictability.
Nishant P: infra note — commit windows add burstiness at month boundaries. autoscaler needs better ramp rules.
Jordan R: product angle — customers who asked want cheaper baseline + temporary boost. they hate surprise preemption.
Carmen L: agreed. constraints: SLA for baseline, soft-fallback for spikes, and billing clarity. launch must include docs + migration guide.
Eli V: what if we do hybrid: 'steady-slab' baseline (committed) + a defined monthly buffer that can be drawn down and refilled (time-boxed credits)?
Nishant P: that's basically a capped burst bucket. implementation risk: eviction fairness and prefix-cache retention. will require scheduler changes.
Jordan R: customers mentioned they want carryover across billing cycles (up to limit). is that negotiable with the capped-bucket model?
Carmen L: yes, carryover up to 25% was suggested by sales. need to model economics. can we simulate 6 customers at different usage curves?
Eli V: I can run a quick simulator. need assumptions: baseline commitment, bucket size, carryover cap, preemption priority rule.
Nishant P: for autoscale behavior, propose: 1) allow immediate bucket draw for latency-sensitive calls, 2) rate-limit refill to avoid thundering, 3) preemption based on tenant priority + recent bucket usage.
Jordan R: launch checklist idea: docs, billing UI showing bucket level, contract language, SLOs, migration script, and 2 test customers for beta.
Carmen L: acceptance criteria: no >2x latency regressions in beta, bounded cost variance (<15% vs forecast), and clear UI for tenants.
Eli V: question: do we expose bucket as API (so app can proactively top-up) or keep it opaque?
Nishant P: ops-wise opaque is simpler. exposing it adds complexity and abuse risk. maybe read-only API for observability.
Jordan R: sales wants top-up option (paid top-ups) as an upsell. we should evaluate product complexity tradeoff.
Carmen L: scope negotiation: MVP = steady-slab baseline + capped monthly bucket with carryover limited to 25%, read-only API, no paid top-ups. beta customers can request paid top-ups via ops manual.
Eli V: timeline? engineering estimates for scheduler + billing changes?
Nishant P: rough: scheduler changes 3w, billing + UI 2w, docs + migration 1w. total ~6 weeks with a small buffer.
Carmen L: ok target: feature-flagged beta in 6 weeks. depending on simulator results we may tweak carryover cap.
ordan R: (typo) Jordan R: noted. I'll coordinate with SEs to line up two beta customers.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for feature/commit-window-sim at 2295012355 — build passed :white_check_mark: 
Eli V: I'll post simulator results by EOD tomorrow and include cost variance numbers.
ishant p: small follow-up — need to add a metric for "bucket churn" to infra dashboards before beta.
Carmen L: thanks all. I'll write this up and share a concise RFC for signoff. :thumbsup:
